normalized.result: Yes, that fallback feels right. If Trove can't reach the page, I wouldn't want to just be stuck — so it's good that it tells me plainly it couldn't get the details but the link can still be saved, and lets me type in a title myself with a description if I feel like it. And requiring just the title as the minimum is sensible; that's the one thing I'd need to recognize the link later, and the description being optional is fine. This works for me.
